metaDescription: Explore Ephesus, Priene, Miletus and Didyma on a 3-day archaeology tour through ancient cities and the classical heritage of Turkey's Aegean region.

summary:
The 3-Day Western Turkey Tour is a compact journey through the archaeological highlights of Turkey’s Aegean region. Explore the marble streets and monuments of Ephesus, discover the ancient Ionian cities of Priene and Miletus, visit the Temple of Apollo at Didyma, and finish among Pamukkale’s white travertine terraces and the ruins of Hierapolis.
The tour can start on your preferred date, making it easy to fit into a longer Turkey itinerary. We take care of the main arrangements, including selected 4-star hotels with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, two domestic flights, airport transfers, entrance fees and the guided sightseeing included in the program.

itinerary.title: Flight to Izmir & Ephesus tour
itinerary.text: At 04:00, transfer to Istanbul Airport for your morning flight to Izmir at 07:00. Upon arrival at 08:10, continue to Ephesus, one of the best-preserved Greco-Roman ancient cities in the world. Explore its marble streets, the magnificent Library of Celsus, and the Great Theatre. The tour also includes visits to the House of the Virgin Mary and the remains of the Temple of Artemis. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Priene, Miletus & Didyma Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast, depart for Priene, once one of the most important ancient Ionian cities. Continue to Miletus to explore its impressive theatre and Byzantine fortress. The tour concludes at Didyma, home to the magnificent Temple of Apollo, the largest Ionic temple of the ancient world, and the famous fallen head of Medusa. After the tour, transfer back to your hotel. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Pamukkale Tour & Flight to Istanbul
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 07:30, depart for Pamukkale to explore its famous white travertine terraces and the ancient city of Hierapolis. Guests may also swim at the famous Cleopatra Antique Pools (optional, extra entrance fee applies). After the tour, transfer to Denizli Airport for your flight to Istanbul at 21:15. Upon arrival at 22:35, meet and transfer to your hotel.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 3-Day Western Turkey Tour?
faqs.a: The 3-Day Western Turkey Tour covers Didyma, Priene, Miletos, Ephesus, and Pamukkale. You will explore some of the most important archaeological sites of the ancient Greek and Roman world, including the Temple of Apollo at Didyma, the ancient cities of Priene and Miletos, the remarkable ruins of Ephesus, and the stunning white travertine terraces of Pamukkale. The tour runs for 2 nights and 3 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 3-Day Western Turkey Tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €855 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, two domestic flights, guided sightseeing tours, entrance fees, selected meals, airport transfers, and hotel transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates, hotel category, and availability.

faqs.q: Are domestic flights included in this itinerary?
faqs.a: Yes, the package includes two domestic flights. These flights help minimize travel time and allow you to focus on exploring Western Turkey's most significant historical and archaeological attractions.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes 2 nights at carefully selected 4-star hotels or boutique accommodations with daily breakfast. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, service quality, and convenient locations near the tour destinations. All airport and hotel transfers are included.

faqs.q: Does the 3-day Western Turkey tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during all scheduled sightseeing tours. As part of the small-group experience, your guide will provide historical background, cultural insights, and detailed information about the ancient civilizations that once flourished in the region.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Turkey?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for travelers interested in Turkey's rich archaeological heritage. It offers a concentrated experience of some of the country's most important ancient cities and UNESCO-listed attractions, making it an excellent choice for history enthusiasts and first-time visitors alike.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, ancient streets, and uneven terrain. Sites such as Ephesus, Priene, and Pamukkale require moderate walking, but most travelers in average health can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Didyma, Priene, Miletos, Ephesus, and Pamukkale?
faqs.a: Highlights include the impressive Temple of Apollo in Didyma, the well-preserved theater and city layout of Priene, the ancient harbor city of Miletos, the Library of Celsus and Great Theatre in Ephesus, and Pamukkale's famous white travertine terraces and the ruins of Hierapolis.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 3-Day Western Turkey Tour?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Is the 3-Day Western Turkey Tour available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour operates throughout the year and can be customized according to your preferences. You can upgrade hotel categories, add extra nights, include additional sightseeing opportunities, or modify the itinerary. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
